visual_review.notes: Reviewed on H3 video. Idle v1 rejected every frame: its gold-heavy attack_01 guide pushed the green-plate edge threshold past the plate's reach. Idle v7, guided by the neutral pose alone, loops smoothly. Attack v1 to v3 all burst at the bash; v3 keeps one clean bash (wind-up to 17, reach from 23 to 34, return from 50), skipping both bursts, a second lunge and two green-fringed blur frames. Ranged v1 skips the shot flash (43-48). Hit v1 shot a beam; hit v2 is used without a faint streak at 4 and a sliver at 14 (v3 cut from a closer framing at 24). Defend v1 is used up to frame 59, before rejected plates. Cast v1 is clean. The walk and death keep the published clips. Re-matted 2026-10-14 with the green-plate spill limit: the green rims on thin and blurred edges are gone, with the same frames, timing, anchor and scale.
